item.title: [Lanka Talks] Tea planters bemoan fertiliser subsidy bureaucracy
item.description: National Tea Planters Association says 50% plantation owners not registering for Govt fertiliser subsidy due to procedures - President Saman Geeganage says youth moving away from tea to garment sector. Need to attend tea adviser, smallholder committees. Urea 709 bag Rs 13,000 unaffordable, production down 3.6% despite export income up. 500,000 plantation owners, half not registered. Plantation companies can't invest in worker welfare, youth choose garment jobs.
